scope: Distinct exact-text pairs from saved top-three candidates for flagged s1 and Qwen13 items, per-document coverage >0.5, and saved fuzzy candidates scoring >=75. Retains original benchmark memberships. Not all corpus matches; no new retrieval or filter runs.
evidence_scope: Saved matched n-grams and scores plus original and corrected benchmark-item decisions. Missing saved pair matches for a method mean unavailable evidence, not a negative decision; only top-three matches were retained. N-gram strings are normalized or tokenizer-decoded displays, not necessarily verbatim substrings.

rules.s1-8gram-word: Any shared 8-gram of lowercased whitespace tokens.
rules.ot3-13gram-qwen: Any shared 13-gram of Qwen tokens (original run).
rules.ot3-paper-or75: Shared Qwen 13-gram OR raw-text RapidFuzz ratio >=75 (postprocessed variant).
rules.tulu3-8gram-50pct: Whitespace 8-grams cover >0.5 of benchmark tokens across the union of corpus documents (original implementation).
rules.coverage-best-document-adaptation: Whitespace 8-grams cover >0.5 of benchmark tokens within one document (postprocessed variant, still an adaptation).
rules.decon-default: Verified successful default Rust run returned zero; no per-pair scores are available here.
